dct_title_s: To Her Most Sacred Majesty Caroline, Queen of Great Britain, France, and Ireland this Mapp of Africa, after the latest and best Observations is most humbly dedicated
dct_description_sm: Borders illustrate thirteen scenes of African life and African forts.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0079, p. 94
